title: Philosophical Calculator Demo
overview: A walkthrough demonstration of the Philosophical Calculator app, showing how to input a prompt, run a pipeline to draft an article, execute analytical lenses (multi-perspective analysis), review results, and illustrate the article with AI-generated images — all for about 62 cents.
